data.one_liner: Protocol and utilities to implement or invoke persistent Bazel workers
data.what_it_does: Provides abstract classes for synchronous and asynchronous worker loops, generated protobuf messages, and testing helpers for building Bazel worker processes in Dart.
use_when: You need to write a Bazel worker in Dart
You want to test worker logic locally
You need a lightweight, no‑extra‑dependency worker framework
avoid_when: You are building a UI widget library
You need a high‑level networking client
strengths: Simple API with clear sync/async separation
Built‑in protobuf support and generated messages
Includes testing utilities for unit tests
weaknesses: Only supports Bazel workers, not general IPC
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, extend AsyncWorkerLoop or SyncWorkerLoop
